id: title:Gilbert09:treat a dropped framer handshake as retryable

review.posthog_relevance: Adds exception handling and test updates for warehouse ingestion connection recovery, potentially improving reliability of warehouse ingestion.
review.reason: Adds a new exception handler for ConnectionClosed errors during the handshake phase, raising a retryable FramerAPIError, and updates imports and tests. This could help recover from transient TLS/TCP connection drops during the handshake phase, potentially improving warehouse ingestion reliability.
